sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect information directly provided by enterprise clients, website visitors, and authorized API integrators: Account & Contact Information (Name, work email, phone number, company name), API & Integration Telemetry (Log data, webhook requests, timestamp meta), and Device & Analytics Meta.

sections.title: 2. AI Processing Safeguards & Model Training
sections.content: SmartFiQ connects to enterprise-tier Large Language Model (LLM) providers under strict Zero Data Retention (ZDR) and Non-Training Service Level Agreements. Your proprietary business records, client chat logs, and vector embeddings are NEVER submitted to public LLM datasets for model retraining.

sections.title: 3. GDPR & International Privacy Compliance
sections.content: We comply with global privacy frameworks including GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) and Indian DPDP Act. Users retain Right to Access, Right to Erasure (Forget Me within 30 days), and TLS 1.3 AES-256 data encryption in transit and at rest.

sections.title: 4. Data Retention & Third-Party Vendors
sections.content: We retain client logs only for the minimum operational timeframe required to maintain workflow state and analytics accuracy. We do not sell, rent, or monetize your business data to third-party ad networks or brokers.

sections.title: 5. Contact Privacy Officer
sections.content: For privacy inquiries, data deletion requests, or security audits, contact our Data Governance Officer at smartfiqagency@gmail.com.

sections.title: 1. Acceptable Use Policy
sections.content: By accessing SmartFiQ platforms and API endpoints, clients agree to adhere to strict ethical and legal usage criteria. Clients must not use WhatsApp broadcast tools or AI voice agents to transmit unsolicited spam, deceptive phishing attempts, or illegal content.

sections.title: 2. Intellectual Property Rights
sections.content: SmartFiQ retains all rights, titles, and ownership over underlying software frameworks, AI prompt architectures, custom CRM code, and proprietary algorithms. Clients retain 100% ownership over their business data, customer records, and generated assets.

sections.title: 3. Service Availability, Rate Limits & SLAs
sections.content: We strive to maintain 99.9% operational uptime across our AI gateway servers. Standard API tiers enforce dynamic request-per-minute rate limits.

sections.title: 4. Limitation of Liability
sections.content: SmartFiQ AI Solutions shall not be held liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from third-party API downtime (e.g., Meta/WhatsApp API outages, OpenAI model latency, or external CRM service disruptions) beyond our direct control.

sections.title: 5. Inquiries & Legal Notices
sections.content: Questions regarding these Terms or enterprise SLA contracts should be directed to smartfiqagency@gmail.com.

faqs.question: How quickly can SmartFiQ deploy AI agents for my business?
faqs.answer: Standard WhatsApp AI agents and lead-qualification workflows can be deployed within 48 to 72 hours. Custom LLM integrations with legacy ERP/CRMs typically take 5 to 7 business days including sandboxed testing.

faqs.question: Do I need an official Meta WhatsApp Business API account?
faqs.answer: Yes! We assist in setting up official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API credentials with Green Tick verification support. This guarantees 100% compliance with zero risk of phone number blocking compared to unofficial scrapers.

faqs.question: Is my enterprise customer data safe from public LLM training?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. All SmartFiQ pipelines operate under Zero Data Retention (ZDR) enterprise agreements. Your chat transcripts, vector embeddings, and customer details are NEVER used to retrain public models.

faqs.question: Can SmartFiQ sync leads directly to HubSpot, Zoho, or Google Sheets?
faqs.answer: Yes! We build automated bidirectional webhooks that sync leads, appointment bookings, and conversation scores directly to your preferred CRM, Google Sheet, or custom database in real-time.

faqs.question: What pricing options are available for ongoing support?
faqs.answer: We offer Starter, Professional, and Enterprise packages. You can choose transparent monthly subscriptions or project-based custom contracts.

faqs.question: What happens if an AI bot encounters a complex customer query?
faqs.answer: SmartFiQ bots feature smooth Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) handoff triggers. If a query falls outside defined confidence thresholds, the bot seamlessly hands off the conversation to a human support agent without breaking the chat session.
